summary: S05a covers LE/30__System__SheetTools and LE/31__System__DocumentKeys (+ the KeyScope leaf they need). TV: 24 files, 15,056 lines (+237 KeyScope); VV: 19 files, 9,913 lines. 16 shared files drifted, 2 header-only, 6 TV-only (LayerMenu, CopyDrag, HoverTooltip, NoteTooltip, DocumentKeys + its JSON), 1 VV-only (Snapping, moved by TV to 28__System__ObjectSnap). Every VV-only line in the shared files was examined: apart from banners, PORT NOTEs, two console prefixes, the Snapping imports and the superseded ItemClipboard adaptations, VV holds only older TV code, so whole-file ports are safe. The eight hub files (PointerDrag, PointerPress, Keyboard, HitResolution, SheetTools__, State, ToolState, SheetTools__ContextMenu) plus CopyDrag must move as one atomic package, and only after twelve TV-only systems (ObjectSnap/MoveAnchor/ViewportSnapMove, Ortho, Grid, Axes, Draft, VectorTools, FloorAreas, NoteRegions tool, SheetImages, PlanDoors, ModelSource, ViewportRotation), a set of shared-module exports and the 03__Core__Config readers exist in VV; otherwise the lazy editor fails to link or v2.78/v2.117/v2.119/v2.144 features silently stay off. Leaf modules (ContextMenu card, HoverTooltip, EditScope, ItemClipboard, SelectionSet/Box, Eyedropper, LayerMenu, NoteTooltip, Grips, Measurements) have superset APIs and can land earlier. Version numbers and devlogs are unreliable diff keys (numbering collisions; unlogged TV changes in commits 32767407 and 4f6bb9ef and v2.152.0). KeyScope fixes live VV faults by code reading: VV's 3D hotkeys fire under drawing tabs (V toggles the carousel, R resets the hidden camera, T enters Walk) and eat letters typed into contenteditable plan annotation labels. VV's key-map fallback also has TV's v2.115 bug (no Move key, Space deselects). 12 TV tests cover the slice and all pass at TV HEAD; VV has none. VV export verifier baseline PASS (139 files).

findings.recommendation: No rename. Align membership by adding the four TV files (S05a-F08..F11) and retiring VV's Snapping__ once S04b has ported 28__System__ObjectSnap (S05a-F29).

decisions_needed.question: After a whole-file port, does the VV file take TV's module version number and DEVELOPMENT LOG, or keep VV's own numbering?
decisions_needed.options: (a) TV's version and DEVELOPMENT LOG verbatim; PORT NOTE says ported whole from TrueVision3D v2.172.0 (HEAD b2aa9151); VV's prior history in one PORT NOTE line and the VV devlog. (b) Keep VV numbering and add one VV entry per port.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). VV numbers already collide with TV numbers for different content (SheetTools__ContextMenu 1.2.0) and VV logs omit ported code (Measurements); matching numbers make the next parity check a string comparison.

decisions_needed.question: When and how should the eight hub files land?
decisions_needed.options: (a) Wait until every TV-only module and shared export they import exists in VV, then port atomically. (b) Port now with throwaway stub modules carrying the missing exports. (c) Port with branches stripped for systems VV will never take.
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). No partial hub links; stubs are throwaway work that hides inert features; stripping is only right for a system Adam excludes under D-S05a-03.

decisions_needed.question: Which TV systems does ValeVision take: Floor Areas, Note Regions, Sheet Images, Plan Doors, Model Source, Vector tools and Booleans, Draft mode, Drawing Grid, Ortho, Drawing Axes, Move anchor, Viewport rotation?
decisions_needed.options: Per system: take code and feature; take the code only (present so the hub links, feature unused); or exclude (hub branch stripped, recorded as a seam).
decisions_needed.recommendation: Take all for an identical Drawing Layout Editor. Model Source as code that shows nothing on VV's one-model projects (ledger lines 70, 86). Sheet Images code with the hub; its storage via VV's own worker and Flask routes in its own slice (DIV-4).

decisions_needed.question: Rename the hotkey files to TV's per-tab names?

(b) As (a) and also adopt TV's 02__AppData/Na__Hotkeys__3dModelTab__.json and 10__NavigationAndCameras/Na__Hotkeys__Manager.js. (c) Keep VV's names.

decisions_needed.question: Which paste rule does VV use: TV's exact coordinates or VV's kept-on-paper adaptation?
